links.outcome: Cross-institution generalizability of LLM mobility extraction across three healthcare institutions
links.effect: Authors report the local deterministic setup demonstrated cross-institution generalizability across three institutions; overall patient-level micro-F1 was 0.876 for Mobility Extraction and 0.897 for Impairment Classification.
links.quote: A local, deterministic setup improved trustworthiness by ensuring consistent outputs, safeguarding privacy, and demonstrating cross-institution generalizability.

unlisted_practices: Task decomposition and few-shot prompting strategies for LLM information extraction from clinical notes
Secondary error analysis counting clinically reasonable inferences as correct

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (Llama 3) for clinical NLP extraction across 600 clinical notes, comparing prompt engineering strategies (zero-shot, few-shot, task decomposition) and assessing clinical plausibility/error analysis.
